en_body:
Gorakhpur police have planned increased monitoring for Chhath Puja at river ghats, markets and other crowded locations. According to Amar Ujala's November 13 report, the plan includes drone surveillance at sensitive ghats and readiness of rescue teams near water bodies. The photograph is a representative older Gorakhpur Chhath preparation image, not a picture of the 2026 security deployment.
